title: The flag up, 2025
logline: Christmas Eve, the mailbox, the flag up again. Second time. The page draws the road toward town this year, not the porch light. Something sent, twice.

margin.note: The crab, small, beside the word.

panels.composition: A roadside mailbox at dusk with its red flag up, and beyond it the wet road running toward the town's few lights, the sea's gray at the road's end.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a roadside mailbox at dusk with its red flag raised and a wet road beyond running toward a small town's few lights with gray sea at the end, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
